name: Potter Knowledge Graph
description: Typed entities, relations and provenance for Potter. Owns one SQLite file and never touches OpenClaw's own tables.

dbPath.description: Absolute path of the graph's SQLite file. Default: <OpenClaw state dir>/potter-kg/potter-kg.sqlite.

decisionAgentId.description: Agent whose decision model kg_check_connection uses. Default: the global decision model.
